INCOME PERSPECTIVE

Estimate your dividend income.

Editable assumptions

Every fund starts with an illustrative 2% yield, not a current reported yield. Replace it with a dividend yield from the issuer. Each estimate assumes the full investment goes into that fund.

Annual income = investment × assumed yield. Monthly equivalents are averages, not payment schedules. Horizon income applies the same yield to the projected end balance; it is a run rate, not cumulative dividends. These pre-tax estimates exclude withholding and currency conversion. Distributions vary and are not guaranteed. The growth chart assumes total return with dividends reinvested: do not add this income to its balance. About fund distributions

Read issuer documents before investing
Sources & calculation methodology

Expense ratios are a static issuer-source snapshot checked November 18, 2026. They do not refresh automatically. Source links appear in the comparison. Fund fees can change. This tool includes a small curated US-listed fund universe; use the issuer links to research holdings, risks and current performance.

Monthly compounding uses (1 + gross annual return − annual expense ratio)^(1/12) − 1, with contributions at each month-end. Fee drag is the difference from an otherwise identical no-fee scenario, including foregone growth; it is not a statement of actual fees paid. Excludes taxes, inflation, commissions, spreads, currency conversion and tracking differences. Assumptions are illustrative and not investment advice. Selections and inputs are saved only in this browser.
